description: This file implements the 'CancellationSourcesExtension' class, which manages cancellation token sources associated with grain activation in Orleans runtime. It handles registration, cancellation, expiration, and cleanup of tokens, integrating with Orleans runtime components such as logging and grain extension interfaces.

classes.name: CancellationSourcesExtension
classes.description: Manages cancellation token sources linked to grain activation, allowing for remote cancellation, automatic cleanup, and expiration of tokens within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a cancellation token entry with timestamp for expiration management within 'CancellationSourcesExtension'.

methods.name: CancelRemoteToken
methods.description: Handles remote cancellation requests by token ID.

methods.name: RegisterCancellationTokens
methods.description: Associates GrainCancellationTokens from requests into the extension for management and cancellation.

methods.name: RecordCancellationToken
methods.description: Records or retrieves a cancellation token within the extension, initiating cancellation if requested.

methods.name: ExpireTokens
methods.description: Removes expired tokens based on their age for cleanup.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes internal resources such as timers.

methods.name: Touch
methods.description: Updates the creation timestamp of the token entry to mark it as active.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Determines if a token has expired based on timestamp and defined expiry duration.

methods.name: LogCancellationFailed
methods.description: Logs a warning when an attempt to cancel a non-existent token is received.
